pages.text: At the edge of Glowmoss Meadow lived Tilly, a tiny firefly with a lantern that flickered instead of glowed. Every evening she practiced shining, but her light only blinked like a sleepy star.
pages.prompt: Tilly the firefly sitting on the left of a mossy log at dusk, her lantern tail flickering, with soft purple sky in the background.

pages.text:
"Tonight is the Lantern Bug Parade!" buzzed Mr. Pebble the beetle. "Every bug who glows gets to march."

Tilly looked at her flickering lantern and sighed.
pages.prompt: Mr. Pebble the beetle in the foreground holding a parade banner, while Tilly hovers on the right looking at her dim lantern.

pages.text: She flew past the snoring snails, over the dandelion clocks, under the tall bending grasses, around the whispering puddle where the frogs were humming their evening song, and all the way to the old hollow log where the wise moth Granny Dusk kept her books of light. Granny Dusk smiled.
pages.prompt: Tilly flying past snoring snails and dandelion clocks, with an old hollow log at the bottom of the scene.

pages.text: "A flicker is not a broken light," said Granny Dusk. "It is a light that dances." Tilly blinked her lantern on and off, on and off. It did look a little like dancing!
pages.prompt: Granny Dusk the moth wearing tiny spectacles beside a stack of glowing books, Tilly blinking happily.

pages.text: On the way back, Tilly heard a tiny cry. A baby ladybug was lost in the tall grass. "I can't find my way home!" she sniffled.
pages.prompt: A baby ladybug crying in tall grass on the right, Tilly hovering above with a worried face.

pages.text: Tilly flickered her lantern high above the grass. On, off, on, off! The baby ladybug followed the dancing light all the way to her family's leaf.
pages.prompt: Tilly's lantern dancing high above the grass at the top of the page, the baby ladybug following below.

pages.text: When the parade began, the other bugs glowed steady and bright. But Tilly danced her light in loops and swirls. The crowd of bugs cheered and cheered.
pages.prompt: A parade of glowing bugs marching across a meadow, Tilly swirling loops of light in the sky.

pages.text: From that night on, Tilly never wished for a different light. Her flicker was the friendliest light in all of Glowmoss Meadow. The end.
pages.prompt: Tilly resting on a dandelion at night, her lantern making a heart-shaped glow in the foreground.
